candidates.description: This feature vector activates on common Hindi subword tokens and morphological suffixes.
This vector activates strongly on subwords and fragments from non-Latin scripts, particularly Devanagari and Greek, alongside random string manipulation artifacts.
This vector represents mixed multilingual text fragments and numbers lacking a unified semantic concept.
This vector activates strongly on Hindi vowel signs and specific Devanagari vowel conjuncts.
This feature vector represents retroflex consonants and related character sequences in the Devanagari script.
This feature vector activates strongly on specific sub-word tokens and characters commonly found in Hindi script.
This feature activates on occurrences of the Devanagari letter 'फ' (pha) and similar glyphs.
This vector activates for Hindi determiners, pronouns, and quantifiers expressing amounts, distinctions, or indefiniteness.
These tokens represent Devanagari vowel sign and punctuation combinations frequently used at the end of Hindi words.
This vector represents vowel characters and independent vowel signs from Indic scripts and their romanized phonetic equivalents.
